# s284 — ai relay tells the orchestrator to record each step with relay-run

`slicer ai relay` tells the orchestrator to call `relay-run begin` when a relay starts, `relay-run step` as each role and subagent starts and finishes, and `relay-run end` at the close, so the board has data without extra prompting.

**Findings:** owner request, session 2026-10-14: monitor slice relays from the TUI · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**2026-10-15** — Verified and gated PASS. ai relay Order carries the relay-run recording steps: begin ID --worktree PATH, where PATH is the slice worktree; step RUN --role ROLE --agent AGENT --phase start, then step RUN --step STEP --phase done or fail when the step ends; subagents add --parent STEP; a long-running step is re-recorded as a heartbeat with step RUN --step STEP --phase start; end RUN --outcome pass (or fail or stopped) after the finish step or when the relay stops, after marking each step done or failed. Recording is advisory: a failed relay-run call never stops the relay. Owner decision: the three handoff-project tests (test_Relay_HandoffProject_ClosesWithHandoffAndNeverDone, test_RelayText_Handoff_StillOmitsDone, test_Relay_ReadsConfigAndIndex_WithoutLockingOrWriting) now forbid the finish command (slicer done) and the phrase run done, not the bare word done, because --phase done is a relay-run phase. relay-run list text rows label the items and the worktree (items s283  wt s283) and use the singular for one step and one subagent; the JSON is unchanged. These cli.py and test_relay_run.py changes are outside the slice Files section and were approved by the orchestrator.
